DXQL.Title: Quest Log
DXQL.NotReady: The quest log is set up the first time a GM joins the world.
DXQL.EmptyLog: No quests yet. Start one when the party picks up a lead.
DXQL.NewQuestHint: Add a quest to the log
DXQL.DeleteQuestConfirm: Delete {title} with all its objectives, notes and clues? This can't be undone.
DXQL.DeleteNoteConfirm: Delete this entry? This can't be undone.
DXQL.SourceGone: The original message or journal entry no longer exists.
DXQL.NoAccess: You don't have access to that.
DXQL.MarkItemMissing: The party doesn't have it yet
DXQL.AddImageHint: Upload images from your computer (or drop or paste them here)
DXQL.AttachImageHint: Attach images (you can also paste or drop them into the text box)
DXQL.BrowseHint: Pick an image that is already on the server
DXQL.NoNotes: No notes yet. Write down what the party learned.
DXQL.UnlinkGiver: Remove the link to the actor

Placeholder.Title: The Missing Blacksmith
Placeholder.Location: Add a place and press Enter
Placeholder.Tag: Add a tag and press Enter
Placeholder.NewItem: Add an item the quest needs…
Placeholder.Clue: What did you find? (Ctrl+Enter to post)
Placeholder.StageText: A sentence or two about this part of the quest.

Hint.Giver: Drop an actor here to link it.
Hint.GiverDrop: Drop an actor here to set the quest giver
Hint.Links: Drop actors, items, journal entries or scenes into the text to link them.
Hint.Hidden: Players can't see the quest until you reveal it.
Hint.HideParts: Use the eye buttons to hide single fields from players. In the quest window you can also hide each objective, note, clue and image.
Hint.Places: Press Enter or type a comma to add a place. Drop the place with ×.
Hint.Items: Type a name and press Enter, or drop an item here to link it. Tick an item when the party has it.
Hint.Npcs: Type a name and press Enter, or drop an actor here to link it.
Hint.NpcsFaces: Type a name and press Enter, or drop an actor here. NPCs from Familiar Faces & Places that an objective or stage mentions are added by themselves.
Hint.NpcLinks: Type @ and the start of a name in an objective or stage to link an NPC from Familiar Faces & Places.

DXQL.UploadTimeout: The GM didn't answer the upload in time.
DXQL.NeedGMForUpload: A GM must be online to upload images for you (or give your role the "Upload new files" permission).

Ctx.SelectionQuest: Start a new quest from selection
Ctx.SelectionReward: Add selection as a quest reward…
Ctx.SelectionPartyNote: Add selection as a note in Notes…

Notify.Name: Announce quest changes
Notify.Hint: Show a notification to everyone when a quest is added, revealed, completed, failed or reopened, or a hidden part of it is revealed; when a quest reward is added, revealed, used, used up, marked claimed or made active again; and when a note is added or revealed.

PlayersCanDelete.Name: Players can delete anything
PlayersCanDelete.Hint: When off, players can only delete the quests, objectives, notes and images they added themselves. The GM can always delete everything.

AdventureImport.Name: Import quests from adventures
AdventureImport.Hint: When a GM imports an adventure that has quests, quest rewards or notes stored in it, add them to the quest log, hidden from players until revealed. This is the default for the Quest Log checkboxes in the adventure's import window. Quests already in the log are left as they are.

ImageFolder.Name: Image folder
ImageFolder.Hint: Where uploaded quest images are stored, relative to the Foundry data folder. Leave empty for worlds/<this world>/quest-log.

SelectionMenu.Name: Right-click menu for selected text
SelectionMenu.Hint: Right-clicking selected text (in chat, journals, sheets) opens a menu to add it to the quest log. Hold Shift to get the normal menu.

DeleteAll.Name: Delete all quests
DeleteAll.Label: Delete all quests…
DeleteAll.Hint: Deletes every quest in the log, hidden ones included, with their objectives, notes, clues and images. Asks for confirmation first and lets you export the log before deleting. It can't be undone.

OfferRewards.Name: Offer quest rewards on completion
OfferRewards.Hint: When a quest with a reward is completed, ask the GM whether to add anything from its reward to the party's Quest Rewards. Only GMs are asked: the GM who completed the quest, or (when a player completed it) the GM in charge.

Transfer.ExportIntro: Save the quest log as a JSON file, to back it up or to bring it into another world.
Transfer.ImagesNote: Images are saved as file paths, not copied into the file. They show up after an import when the image files exist on that server.
Transfer.NothingToExport: There are no quests to export.
Transfer.NotAnExport: The file isn't a quest log export.
Transfer.NoQuestsInFile: The file has no quests in it.
Transfer.HiddenNote: {count} of them are hidden from players, or have parts hidden from players, and stay that way.
Transfer.MergeHint: The quests are added next to the ones already in the log.
Transfer.MergeHintOverlap: The quests are added next to the ones already in the log. {count} of them are already in it and are replaced by the version in the file.
Transfer.ReplaceHint: Deletes the {count} quests in the log now and keeps only the ones in the file. If the file has quest rewards, the rewards are replaced the same way.
Transfer.ReplaceConfirm: This deletes all {count} quests in the log now, with their notes, clues and objectives, and can't be undone. Export the log first if you might want them back. Replace it?
Transfer.ExportedAll: Exported {count} quests, {rewards} quest rewards and {notes} notes.
Transfer.ImportSummaryAll: {count} quests, {rewards} quest rewards and {notes} notes in {file}.
Transfer.ImportedAll: Imported {count} quests, {rewards} quest rewards and {notes} notes.

DXQL.FieldHiddenHint: Hidden from players – click to show it to them
DXQL.HiddenPartsHint: Parts of this quest are hidden from players
DXQL.AddsHidden: New entries are hidden from players – click to add them visible
DXQL.AddsVisible: New entries are visible to players – click to add them hidden

Npc.Auto: Added because an objective or stage mentions this NPC

Adventure.NoQuests: The adventure {title} has no quests stored in it.
Adventure.ReadError: Could not read the quests stored in {title}: {error}
Adventure.Imported: Added {count} quests from {title} to the quest log ({hidden} hidden from players).
Adventure.Skipped: {count} quests from {title} were already in the quest log and were left as they are.
Adventure.ImportedExtras: Added {rewards} quest rewards and {notes} notes from {title} to the quest log.
Adventure.ImportHint: Add these to the quest log, hidden from players until revealed. Anything already in the log is left as it is.
Adventure.StoreError: Could not store the quest log in {title}: {error}

QuestLink.NotInLog: This quest isn't in the quest log.
QuestLink.Unavailable: You can't see that quest yet.
QuestLink.PartMissing: That part of the quest isn't in the quest log any more.
QuestLink.HiddenPartOfHidden: Hidden from players (and the quest itself is still hidden)
QuestLink.QuestStillHidden: Unhidden, but {title} itself is still hidden from players.

DXQL.LinkCopied: Copied {link}. Paste it into a journal page or chat to link this quest.
DXQL.DeleteStageConfirm: Delete the stage {title}? Its objectives are kept, without a stage.
DXQL.RevealStage: Show this stage and its objectives to players
DXQL.AddToStage: Add the objective to this stage

Convert.Title: Main/side quest and chapters
Convert.Body: {count} quests use tags for their type or chapter, such as Side quest, Main quest or Chapter 3. Main/side quest and chapter are now categories of their own, which players can group the quest log by. Turn these tags into the categories?
Convert.Hint: Only quests that don't have a type or chapter yet are changed, and only the tags used are removed. Other tags stay.
Convert.Done: Converted the tags of {count} quests into main/side quest and chapter.

DeleteAll.Title: Delete all quests
DeleteAll.Body: This deletes all {count} quests in the quest log for everyone, with their objectives, stages, notes, clues and images. It can't be undone.
DeleteAll.HiddenNote: {count} of them are hidden from players.
DeleteAll.ExportHint: Export the log first if you might want it back. Uploaded image files stay in the image folder.
DeleteAll.Empty: The quest log is already empty.
DeleteAll.Done: Deleted all {count} quests from the quest log.
DeleteAll.AlsoPartyNotes: Also delete all {count} notes in the Notes view

Reward.NewHint: Add a reward the party got
Reward.DeleteConfirm: Delete the reward {name} and its log of uses? This can't be undone.
Reward.UsesRequired: Give the number of uses (or choose No limit).
Reward.Empty: No quest rewards yet. Add the things the party gets and can use later.
Reward.UseHint: Use it once (one use is counted down)
Reward.UndoUseHint: Take back the last use (if it was a mistake)
Reward.LinkCopied: Copied {link}. Paste it into a journal page or chat to link this reward.
Reward.LinkNotInLog: This reward isn't in the quest rewards.
Reward.AddFromQuestHint: Add a quest reward from this quest, with its quest giver and places as links
Reward.KeptHidden: The reward is hidden from players while its quest is hidden.
Reward.QuestHidden: The reward's quest is hidden from players. Reveal the quest first, or remove the link to it.
Reward.Linked: Linked to a document: click it in the reward window to open it

Placeholder.Name: e.g. Favour of the Harbour Guild
Placeholder.Link: A place, NPC or faction – press Enter
Placeholder.Description: What it is, and how the party can use it.

Hint.Item: Drop an item here to use its name, image and a link to it.
Hint.Image: Upload an image (or drop one here)
Hint.Uses: A reward is received with all its uses. Each use counts one down; when none are left, it moves to the claimed rewards. Changing the number of uses keeps the uses already spent.
Hint.NoLimit: Available for as long as the party plays.
Hint.Links: Pick what it is (place, NPC, faction, other), type a name and press Enter. Drop actors, scenes or journal entries here to link them; click a link's icon to change what it is.
Hint.Hidden: Players can't see the reward until you reveal it.

Offer.Title: Quest rewards
Offer.Body: {title} is completed. Add anything from its reward to the party's Quest Rewards?
Offer.Hint: Untick what shouldn't be added and fix the names if needed. Each item opens a reward form filled in from the quest; nothing is added until you save it.
Offer.Already: {count} rewards from this quest are already in the Quest Rewards.

Reward.NotifyUsedUp: {name} used the last use of {title}; it was moved to the claimed rewards.

PartyNote.NewHint: Add a note for the party, about a quest or on its own
PartyNote.DeleteConfirm: Delete the note {title}? This can't be undone.
PartyNote.Empty: No notes yet. Write down anything the party wants to remember: rumours, names, maps, plans.

EmptyFilter.pinned: No pinned notes. Pin a note to keep it at the top.

PartyNote.PinNew: Pin to the top of the list
PartyNote.ShareHint: Post this note to the chat for everyone
PartyNote.ShareHidden: Reveal the note to the players before sharing it.
PartyNote.LinkCopied: Copied {link}. Paste it into a journal page or chat to link this note.
PartyNote.LinkNotInLog: This note isn't in the Notes.
PartyNote.Linked: Linked to a document: click it in the note window to open it
PartyNote.KeptHidden: The note is hidden from players while its quest is hidden.
PartyNote.QuestHidden: The note's quest is hidden from players. Reveal the quest first, or remove the link to it.
PartyNote.AddFromQuestHint: Add a note about this quest to the Notes

Placeholder.Title: e.g. Rumours from the Green Dragon
Placeholder.Text: Whatever the party wants to remember.

Hint.Quest: Leave it as a general note, or pick the quest it is about.
Hint.Text: Drop actors, items, journal entries or scenes here to link them. Paste or drop images to add them.
Hint.Links: Pick what it is (place, NPC, faction, other), type a name and press Enter. Drop actors, scenes or journal entries here to link them; click a link's icon to change what it is.
Hint.Hidden: Players can't see the note until you reveal it.
